 ET Online Reliance Jio has launched a Rs 10,000 prepaid recharge plan offering three years of connectivity through a single payment. The plan provides unlimited voice calls across all networks, 2.5GB of high-speed data every day, unlimited 5G access and 100 SMS daily, along with streaming, productivity and cloud storage benefits.
 The new 36-month plan will be available nationwide from November 7, 2026. It also bundles JioHotstar Mobile + Hollywood, 12 months of Canva Pro Lite and 50GB of complimentary JioAICloud storage.
 What Jio's Rs 10,000 three-year plan offers
The prepaid plan provides the following benefits for its three-year validity period: 
 Price: Rs 10,000
 Validity: Three years or 36 months
 Voice calls: Truly unlimited calls across all networks
 Daily data: 2.5GB of high-speed data per day
 5G connectivity: Unlimited 5G data access
 SMS: 100 SMS per day
 The plan is designed to provide long-term connectivity through a single recharge instead of requiring subscribers to renew their prepaid plans periodically.
Customers paying Rs 10,000 upfront can secure the listed plan benefits and pricing for the entire 36-month period.
 Live Events
 JioHotstar, Canva Pro Lite and 50GB cloud storage included
Along with mobile connectivity, Jio is offering three digital services as part of the package.
 JioHotstar Mobile + Hollywood: Subscribers get access to live sports, Hotstar Originals, premium shows and Hollywood blockbusters.
 Canva Pro Lite: The plan includes 12 months of access to Canva Pro Lite, offering design templates, creative assets and productivity tools.
JioAICloud: Subscribers also receive 50GB of complimentary secure cloud storage for storing documents, photographs and other files.
While the mobile connectivity benefits are offered under the three-year plan, the Canva Pro Lite benefit is specifically valid only for 12 months.
 Where and when can customers recharge?
Jio's Rs 10,000 prepaid plan will go live across India on November 7, 2026.
Customers will be able to purchase the recharge through multiple channels:
 MyJio app
 Official Jio.com website
 Authorised Jio stores
 Retail outlets
 Partner recharge points across the country
 By making a single upfront payment, customers can secure the listed benefits for 36 months without having to undertake periodic recharges during the validity period.
 Jio’s long-term prepaid plans compared
Reliance Jio has several prepaid recharges for customers looking to avoid frequent renewals. These include a new three-year plan, an annual recharge, 90-day options and voice-only packs.
Here are the plans, their benefits and how much they cost per day:
- Rs 10,000 plan – 1,095 days (3 years): Unlimited voice calls, unlimited 5G data, 2.5GB high-speed data per day and 100 SMS daily. It also bundles JioHotstar Mobile + Hollywood, Canva Pro Lite for 12 months and 50GB JioAICloud storage. Cost: Rs 9.13 per day.
- Rs 3,599 plan – 365 days (1 year): Unlimited voice calls, unlimited 5G data, 2.5GB daily data and 100 SMS per day, along with two OTT benefits, including Amazon Prime. Cost: Rs 9.86 per day.
- Rs 1,748 plan – 336 days: Unlimited voice calls, 3,600 SMS, JioTV and JioAICloud. It does not include bundled mobile data. Cost: Rs 5.20 per day.
- Rs 899 plan – 90 days: Unlimited voice calls, 2GB data per day, an additional 20GB and unlimited 5G, along with bundled OTT benefits. Cost: Rs 9.99 per day.
- Rs 1,029 plan – 84 days: Unlimited voice calls, 2GB daily data, unlimited 5G and two OTT benefits, including Amazon Prime. Cost: Rs 12.25 per day.
- Rs 448 plan – 84 days: Unlimited voice calls and SMS, without bundled mobile data. Cost: Rs 5.33 per day.
 Which Jio plan offers the most value?
The Rs 10,000 plan has the lowest daily cost among the listed full-service plans, at around Rs 9.13. Buying the Rs 3,599 annual plan three times would cost Rs 10,797 for the same 1,095 days, making the three-year recharge Rs 797 cheaper. However, the Rs 1,748 plan is the lower-cost option for customers who mainly need calling and do not require mobile data.
